data_actor_description: Threat actor using Keitaro tracker to cloak malicious activity. The cloaking from this actor is very good and it is difficult to trigger the true content. The information we have indicates that the actor is spreading disinformation campaigns, but it is quite possible they are delivering malware and other content based on the sophistication. When the actor rejects the user, they will redirect to a site like Amazon or a legitimate news site. These campaigns appear to be active since late 2024.
